Both of the inventory's named 'live next moves' have since LANDED and are default-on: the log-polar foveal-render (4/4 seeds GO, flipped default ON) + the cascade N-bias FIX1 stochastic tie-break (3/3 seeds GO). With the SC bump finally PRESENT for far goals, the EXACT SAME closed neural-reward->critic->actor loop (spiking_reward_us + enable_neural_critic + spiking_snc, heuristic OFF) now TRACKS the moving goal on the diagonal phases and SUSTAINS navigation (actor late-sustain ~0.97, holds within ~1 cell), at ~2.4x host -- down from ~58x. It was NOT evidence the reward/drive loop is the failure -- it was evidence the orienting INPUT was dead (and the read-out was stuck-N via the host tie-break degeneracy).
move1_isolate_quantify.the_genuine_residual_pinned: Two non-biological modeling choices, both runner-side, both now FIXED: (a) the egocentric retina TRUNCATION (linear ppc=4 over a fixed 32-px field clips far goals off-image -> bump absent); (b) the HOST tie-break degeneracy (Python max() resolves the [40,40,40,40] sel_X accumulator saturation-ties to N(index 0) -> stuck-N read-out regardless of goal). move2_reframe_biology.wrong_hypothesis_tested: The original NO-GO tested 'can a closed neural reward/critic/actor loop SUSTAIN nav?' and concluded NO. But the loop was being fed a DEAD orienting input (absent bump) + read out through a stuck-N (host-tie-break) policy. The right question is upstream: does the SC's INPUT REPRESENTATION guarantee an eccentric target is still represented?
move2_reframe_biology.real_biology: The intermediate/deep superior colliculus holds a LOG-POLAR / foveal-magnified retinotopic saccade map (eccentricity along the rostral-caudal axis with strong foveal magnification; the periphery out to ~45-90deg is COMPRESSED but ALWAYS REPRESENTED -- Ottes-Van Gisbergen-Eggermont afferent log mapping; Hafed lab 2019; catalog E.04 'maps warped by behavioral importance -- cortical magnification -- fovea'; catalog H.25 SC full-hemifield saccade map). A LINEAR, TRUNCATED retina is the NON-biological special case; the biology-faithful SC never truncates. SC build-up/buildup cells then ramp a moving hill of activity to a movement command, gated out by SNr disinhibition (catalog A.07). The 'sustain' the loop needed was never a reward/value problem -- it was the missing foveal-magnified input representation (+ a fair tie-break, Wang-2002 finite-size decision noise breaking genuine ties, not the host N-first ordering).
move2_reframe_biology.omnipause_fixation_reset: Considered (Option E, Munoz; catalog A.07 collicular fixation zone / inhibition-of-return on goal change) but NOT indicated -- the residual is swamping/absence, not hysteresis (the bump re-renders fresh each step; for far goals there was no persisted-old-bump to reset). Held in reserve only if a future log-polar bump attractor shows hysteresis.
